answer_1.quote: In this paper, we presented SSREM, an automatic evaluation model for conversational response generation.

answer_2.quote: We compare SSREM with the following response evaluation methods: • BLEU ... • ROUGE ... • EMB ... • RUBER ... • RSREM ...

answer_4.quote: We ask two questions to the MTurkers. (1) How appropriate is the response overall? (2) How on‑topic is the response? ... The inter‑annotator Fleiss' kappa is κ = 0.61.
answer_4.guideline: Two Likert‑scale questions: overall appropriateness and on‑topic relevance.
